operation.description:
Gets GitHub Actions cache storage limit for a repository. This determines the maximum size of caches that can be
stored before eviction occurs.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:repository` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Get GitHub Actions cache storage limit for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/actions-cache-stora.description: GitHub Actions cache storage policy for a repository.

max_cache_size_gb.description: The maximum total cache size for this repository, in gigabytes.

#/components/schemas/actions-cache-stora.title: Actions cache storage limit for a repository
